set.body:
Objective
Freeze target/brain projections, rank, support, rotation and preprocessing on discovery data, then bind independent confirmation units and the approved nuisance/dependence model.

Authority and inputs
PRD: docs/plans/unified-mvpa-prd.md v0.2; requirements INF-01, INF-05, FND-04. Scientific/architecture/supplementary notes linked there preserve derivations and rationale. Planning baseline e071e83b3a23bc6f304b1e72625d6281d9cfc9ba plus untracked design documents is provenance, not a clean-tree or current-admission claim. Refresh only relevant sources/pins at claim time.

Owner role and starting seams
statistical implementation; confirmation design/compiler; nuisance/error capabilities; holdout exposure ledger. These are bounded ownership candidates, not a reservation of whole modules. Reserve exact touched paths when beginning; no assignee is fabricated by this plan.

Prerequisite packets
M0.05, M1.09, M3.07. Native Mote blocking edges are authoritative; stable keys/IDs are mapped in docs/plans/unified-mvpa-epic.md.

Acceptance
1. The inference contract names conditioning, units, null, generalization, multiplicity family, approximation and selection stages covered.
2. Confirmation-derived tuning/ROI/rotation selection blocks the original untouched-claim path or requires new evidence.
3. Independent Gaussian, dependent fMRI and repeated-measure designs use separately admitted covariance/resampling capabilities.
4. Fast fixed-representation inference does not claim complete selection uncertainty; unsupported assumptions produce actionable refusal.

Verification
sbt mvpaJVM/test ; in a separate bounded invocation: sbt mvpaJS/test
These are candidate owning-module gates at the planning baseline: resolve any renamed module/test IDs at implementation start, and include affected consumer/parity scenarios. Use independent oracles and explicit tolerances; never report pending tests as passing.

Scope and handoff
Implement only this packet and required owner-local tests/docs. Reuse Gale/Multivar kernels, resample4s designs, Alder lifecycle and existing response/locus/estimates facilities; provider gaps stay explicit and require consumer admission. Do not add legacy enum cases or permanent compatibility wrappers, duplicate orchestration, a new registry/runtime, broad repo refactors, or silently change the scientific estimand to pass a resource/statistical gate. Migrate/delete per the M0 ledger. No Git push/release publication or foreign-store mutation is authorized by this ticket.
At handoff attach exact revisions, commands/results, scenario IDs, failure/caveat status, artifacts and next consumer. Semantic, numerical, scope, resource and scientific evidence remain separate. Independent audit tickets must use independently derived expectations/review, not repeat the implementation helper; unresolved criteria keep the task open.
set.title: UMVPA-M4.04: Implement frozen discovery/confirmation and nuisance-aware inference design
